  • Get cooking quickly and efficiently with 7 Express Buttons
  • Add cook time with one touch using the Add 30 Seconds Option
  • The Blue LED Display fits seamlessly into Whirlpool kitchen design
  • Clean up spills easily with the Dishwasher-Safe Turntable Plate

  • Keep food warm while you wrap up the rest of your meal
  • Easily get the settings you need with Microwave Presets
  • Easily turn selection sounds on and off with the touch of a button
  • Create a built-in look with the optional trim kit (sold separately)

  • Take out the guesswork with sensors that track cooking progress
  • Add water to clean your microwave using Steam Clean
